interventions.detail: Docker unavailable; built llama-server from source at the DLC-pinned llama.cpp ref b29c606 with Dockerfile.cpu cmake flags instead of using the server-cpu-v1 image
apt-get install cmake libssl-dev libgomp1 to build llama.cpp on Ubuntu
Built with LLAMA_CURL=OFF and pre-downloaded the GGUF with curl, then served it via --model instead of --hf-repo/--hf-file
Documented HF repo ggml-org/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF returns 401; used Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF's identically named qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf
